title: Does a check that passed only on a re-run count as proof of a green tree?
context: The publish check (ci-green) and the CI skip both read the required checks on the PR head. If a shard failed and passed when re-run, GitHub reports the newest result as success. The experts' rules only count the newest result; the issue does not say.
